  • Method Details

    • uri

      HttpRequest.Builder uri(URI uri)
      Sets the URI the request is sent to.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if its scheme is not http or https, or it has no host

    • header

      HttpRequest.Builder header(String name, String value)
      Adds a header. A name may be added more than once.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is restricted or invalid, the value holds a line break, or the request's headers would pass 512 bytes

    • headers

      HttpRequest.Builder headers(String... namesAndValues)
      Adds each name and value pair, as header(String, String) does.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a name has no value, or as header(String, String)

    • setHeader

      HttpRequest.Builder setHeader(String name, String value)
      Sets a header, replacing every header of that name added before.

    • timeout

      HttpRequest.Builder timeout(Duration duration)
      Sets how long the client waits for the response.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if duration is not positive

    • GET

      HttpRequest.Builder GET()
      Makes the request a GET, with no body: the default.

    • POST

      HttpRequest.Builder POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublisher body)
      Makes the request a POST of body.

    • PUT

      HttpRequest.Builder PUT(HttpRequest.BodyPublisher body)
      Makes the request a PUT of body.

    • DELETE

      HttpRequest.Builder DELETE()
      Makes the request a DELETE, with no body.

    • HEAD

      HttpRequest.Builder HEAD()
      Makes the request a HEAD, with no body: the response has a status and headers but no body.

    • method

      HttpRequest.Builder method(String method, HttpRequest.BodyPublisher body)
      Sets the method and body, for a method such as PATCH or OPTIONS. Unlike the JDK, the board also sends CONNECT: its request target is the URI's host:port, and the response has a status and headers but no body. The board closes the connection after it, so the tunnel cannot be used.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if method is empty or not a token

    • build

      HttpRequest build()
      Builds the request. The builder can go on being used: a later header does not change this request.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no URI was set
